1_kernel_booted_by_cx2e.answer: 6.1.0-53-cloud-arm64 (CX2E tokens/blocker); provision serial also shows initial boot 6.1.0-52-cloud-arm64 before package install of 6.1.0-53-*

2_generic_non_cloud_kernels_installed.answer: linux-image-6.1.0-53-arm64 (via linux-image-arm64 meta) was installed during cloud-init; cloud kernels 6.1.0-52-cloud-arm64 and 6.1.0-53-cloud-arm64 also present

3_generic_kernel_has_virtio_gpu_drm.answer: Expected yes for Debian linux-image-*-arm64 (non-cloud) which ships virtio_gpu + DRM modules; CX2E never booted that kernel so modules were not exercised. Confirmed at CX2F runtime via modinfo/lsmod on selected non-cloud kernel.
3_generic_kernel_has_virtio_gpu_drm.rationale: cloud kernel lacks DRM (/dev/dri absent per CX2E blocker); generic arm64 is the intended DRM path

4_initramfs_modules.answer: Unknown from CX2E offline evidence whether initramfs for 6.1.0-53-arm64 includes virtio_gpu/drm; CX2F regenerates initramfs and verifies module tree before reboot

6_qemu_display_none.impact: no QEMU graphics surface for HMP screendump / VNC inspection

7_chromium_failure_mode.detail: CX2E launched Chromium with --app=file:///opt/cx2e/gunnch_shell/index.html; assets present (SHELL_ASSETS_OK) and process started, but shell_window_rendered stayed false and compositor capture unavailable under headless

9_file_url_asset_resolution_broken.detail: file:///opt/cx2e/gunnch_shell/index.html resolves /assets/* against filesystem root (/assets/...), not the shell directory — production JS/CSS never load under file://

10_user_runtime_mismatch.detail: CX2E Weston unit ran as User=root with XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/cx2e-wayland (root-owned sockets); Chromium launched via SSH as gunnchos. Session may have mismatched ownership/permissions for Wayland attach + AT-SPI

answer.cx2f_primary: QEMU HMP screendump PPM via unix monitor

compound_root_cause: Cloud kernel still defaulted by GRUB despite linux-image-arm64 install → no /dev/dri
Weston auto-rewritten to headless-backend.so when DRM missing
QEMU -display none → no framebuffer surface for screendump
Vite absolute /assets/ + file:// launch → empty Chromium shell UI
Root Weston vs gunnchos Chromium session ownership risk
cx2f_required_repairs: Select+boot newest *-arm64 non-cloud kernel; prove uname
VNC loopback graphics surface + retain virtio-gpu-pci
Weston drm-backend.so only on success path; remove headless success fallback
Loopback static HTTP serve of immutable gunnch_shell build
